title: Tool library dialog: U3 orbitable 3D tool model and a to-scale side view

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

labels.name: P4
labels.description: Work the maintainer asked for, for the next cut

body:
Goal: The tool library window shows the tool as an orbitable 3D model and as a to-scale side view with its key dimensions.

Scope change (24 Nov 2026, decided by the user). The maintainer (Sgt_Hindsight) said:
> "as long as we keep the 3D preview bit, im aiming to develop on that down the line" / "as running weirdly shape tools requires models" / "not just a spun profile"

Thus the old plan (a large 2D drawing with painted flute helix lines) is replaced. The painted flute helix lines are dropped. Helical flutes on the 3D model are the follow-up #3908 (display only).

Parent: #3663. Plan: the implementation plan in the #3663 comment. This is PR U3 of 11. Refs #93: it fixes the preview leftovers.

Files:
- A preview area in the editor of the tool library window. It has two views and a toggle between them:
  - 3D (the default): the orbitable model preview (`preview_3d` in `tool_body_page.rs`, #371). It is always visible, not only while a Pick button is armed. A tool with an imported body (`ToolBody` mesh) shows its real model. A tool without a body shows a mesh that is revolved from its profile: the `Tool::profile` bands (the band stack that the collision check sweeps), the landed drawn cutter (`ToolCutter`), and the holder (`HolderRef::points`, `tool_body_page::envelope` or the cylinder stand-in). Thus the 3D view is never empty.
  - Move the renderer into its own module, so that the maintainer can build on it. Pick tip and Pick axis keep working (`placement_view`).
  - Side (to scale): the flat side view (`tool_preview.rs`, #2002), larger, with dimension lines: diameter, flute length, shank, stick-out, gauge, holder diameter and length. No painted helix lines.
- Change `tool_profile_page.rs` `preview_inputs` to return the landed `ToolCutter` outside "Draw cutter". This also fixes the Properties preview (#93 leftover).
- Frame cost (`crates/ui/AGENTS.md`): cache the revolved mesh and the outlines. Key them on their input (the tool value, the `HolderRef`, the cutter revision, the body mesh identity), not on `doc_version`. Name the piece with `frame_cost::span`. A still frame computes no mesh.

Tests (new): `tool_library_preview::the_3d_view_is_the_default_and_shows_an_imported_body`, `a_tool_without_a_body_shows_a_revolved_model`, `a_landed_drawn_cutter_shows_in_both_views`, `the_side_view_paints_the_dimension_labels`, `a_still_frame_computes_no_mesh`, `a_changed_tool_rebuilds_the_mesh`. Also a test for the open U2 gap: the shape window opens from the editor while Properties shows a different tool. Update `layout_window_tool_editor` and the structural tests. No test is removed.

Depends on: U2 (#3893).

Follow-up: #3908 (helical flutes on the 3D model, display only).

Commands: none. Display only. No law reads the preview.

Expected quick gate: 10 to 20 steps.

Done means: the window shows the tool as an orbitable 3D model by default, and as a to-scale side view with dimension labels. A tool without a body shows a revolved model. A landed drawn cutter shows in the two views and in the Properties preview. A still frame computes no mesh.

Changelog row: The tool library window shows the tool as an orbitable 3D model (its imported body, or a model revolved from its profile) and as a to-scale side view with dimension lines. The tool preview shows a drawn cutter.
